seoTitle: Import eBay & DSers Reviews to Shopify for Free
metaDescription: Add authentic eBay and DSers product reviews to your Shopify store for free with a review app, building social proof without extra cost.
intro: Trusted reviews from platforms like eBay and DSers can make your Shopify listings feel far more credible to new visitors. This guide covers installing a free app extension, connecting it to your store, scanning reviews from eBay and DSers product pages, and customizing how they appear once imported.

steps.heading: Install the free Shopify app extension
steps.body: Add a review-import app from the Shopify app store that supports pulling in reviews from external platforms.

steps.heading: Import reviews from eBay product pages
steps.body: Connect the app to the relevant eBay listing so it can scan and bring in existing customer reviews.

steps.heading: Import reviews from DSers
steps.body: Do the same for matching products sourced through DSers, pulling their reviews into your Shopify catalog.

steps.heading: Customize imported reviews
steps.body: Adjust the display settings so the imported reviews match your store's look and feel.

faq.question: Do I need to pay for this review import method?
faq.answer: No, this method relies on a free app extension to import reviews from eBay and DSers without additional cost.

faq.question: Is this useful for dropshippers specifically?
faq.answer: Yes, it's aimed at dropshippers and store owners who want to add credibility using genuine reviews from trusted platforms.

faq.question: Can I bulk import reviews instead of doing it one by one?
faq.answer: Yes, the process supports importing multiple reviews at once rather than adding them individually.

faq.question: Will imported reviews match my store's theme?
faq.answer: You can customize the review widget's appearance after import so it fits your store's design.
